The '''Jeylac''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] sympathizer [[Aviso]] carried a Jeylac [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] aboard his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], and he attempted to use [[XNA-580]]&mdash;an experimental device that could alter the brainwaves of some species&mdash;to influence the slave's mind.
